sol: Terra over-promoted several culinary assumptions. Belgian Waffle supports milk through explicitly listed butter, but not wheat or egg from the name alone. Tortilla-wrapped Tex Mex Eggrolls do not establish wheat because tortillas may be corn or wheat. Sourdough, brioche, custard, mayonnaise, waffle, and similar culinary terms cannot by themselves establish complete allergen membership without formulation evidence.
